sources.body: RACS (incl. NZ Orthopaedic Association via RACS)
sources.requirement: CPD calendar year 1 Jan-31 Dec, submit by 28 Feb of following year. FAQ states: 'In 2026 all CPD participants will now only have a minimum of 25 hours of Education to complete.' At least 50% of CPD must relate to current Area of Practice. CPD plan required; 5% randomly verified. Total annual hours and practice review / outcome measurement hours NOT FOUND on fetched primary pages.
sources.asOf: 2026-11-09 | A 2024 CPD Guide (reportedly 40h education for specialist surgeons) was seen only in a search summary; PDF could not be read - unverified

sources.requirement: CAPE (cultural safety, addressing health inequity, professionalism, ethical practice) is a regulatory requirement (AMC and MCNZ). At least one activity per year in each of four areas; tracked via competencies: Cultural Competence and Cultural Safety (C) one activity, Health Advocacy (A) one activity, Professionalism (P and E) two activities. No hours stated.
sources.asOf: 2026-11-09 | 2024 article; no Maori-specific mandatory hours found

sources.requirement: NZ participants: structured conversation with a peer is mandatory under their learning plan (optional in Australia).

Cultural safety resource page lists NZ/Maori options (Groundwork 'Applying Te Tiriti', Manatu Hauora online short courses modules 1 and 2, HQSC bias modules, CCEH webinar). Lists are 'not formally endorsed' and give no required minimum activities or hours. No mandatory Maori / te reo hours found.

50 CPD hours per year (unchanged). Practice evaluation: 25 hours/year including min 5h reviewing performance and min 5h measuring outcomes (stated in section on practice without direct patient care; described as regulatory requirement).
sources.asOf: 2026-11-09 | Jan 2026 handbook PDF could not be read; 12.5h knowledge and skills, four mandatory practice-evaluation activities and emergency response activity come only from a search summary - unverified

sources.requirement: Mandatory cultural safety (C) component 'remains unchanged'; from 1 Jan 2026 at least one activity in each of Addressing health inequities (A), Professionalism (P), Ethical practice (E). 'There is no minimum number of hours' per domain; one activity can count towards more than one. No Maori/Te Tiriti-specific requirement; no NZ-specific hours or annual conversation mentioned.

Program-level requirements (CAPE): Cultural Safety 2h, Professionalism 2h, Addressing Health Inequities 2h, Ethical Practice 2h minimum, 'All CPD Participants', mandated from 1 Jan 2025 (8h across four). Year-by-year rotation unclear on page. No Maori-specific requirement.
sources.asOf: 2026-11-09 | Conflicts with program-and-profiles page for 2026 (next row); confirm with cpd@ranzcog.edu.au

sources.requirement: 2026 program-level: Addressing Health Inequities 2 hours and Ethical Practice 2 hours in 2026; no hour requirement set for Cultural Safety or Professionalism on this page. Annual Conversation mandatory for MCNZ-registered participants (counts 2h of PR). PDP counts 3h PR for Fellows. In-person BLS every two years from 2025. Total 50h and EA/OM/PR minimums NOT stated on page.
sources.asOf: 2026-11-09 | Affiliate guideline (50h) seen only in search summary - unverified for Fellows

sources.requirement: 50 hours per calendar year across three categories (Educational Activities; Reviewing Performance and Reflecting on Practice; Measuring and Improving Outcomes); category minimums not stated on page. Annual PDP. Clinical radiologists: anaphylaxis training once per 2026-2028 cycle.

At least one activity per year in each of four PLRs: Professionalism, Addressing Health Inequities, Cultural Safety Practice, Ethical Practice. NZ (MCNZ): structured annual conversation with peer/colleague/employer; cultural safety and health equity must be embedded in CPD activities (recorded via Cultural Competency Form). No Maori-specific hours stated.

NOT VERIFIED from primary page: rcpa.edu.au returned HTTP 403. Search-result summary only (unconfirmed): 50h/yr from 2024, 12.5h education, 25h reviewing performance + measuring outcomes (min 5h each), CAPE one activity each per year.

50h/yr: 12.5h Educational Activities; 25h Reviewing Performance + Measuring Outcomes (min 5h each); 12.5h any category. Core procedural skills airway/breathing/circulation (0.5h each, EA) and four Essential Emergency Medicine skills. PDP with reflection. New leadership high-level requirement from 1 Jan 2026.

Health Outcome activities: at least one each of Ethical Practice, Professionalism, Addressing Health Inequities, and Culturally Safe Practice (with a reflective component). NZ-registered participants: one Annual Conversation per MCNZ. No Maori-specific requirement and no hours for these items.

NOT VERIFIED from primary page: ranzco.edu/cpd returned empty content and the 2024 handbook PDF was unreadable. Search-result summary only (unconfirmed): 50h/yr, 12.5h education, 25h reviewing performance + measuring outcomes (min 5h each), NZ structured annual conversation compulsory (5h per activity), CAPE one activity per area.

Mandatory: PDP; 50 hours of CPD logged; Structured Annual Conversation for Aotearoa NZ practitioners only. Category 1 education min 12.5h; Categories 2+3 combined min 25h with min 5h each. CAPE: at least one activity each year in cultural safety practice, addressing health inequities, professionalism, ethical practice.
sources.asOf: 2026-11-09 | 50h period not explicitly stated on page; CAPE is annual

sources.requirement: Cultural safety page: 'required to consider cultural safety as part of your annual CPD'; no minimum hours or activity count. Examples include HQSC NZ modules on bias, Te Tiriti o Waitangi, colonisation, racism, and M&M review recording whether patient identified as Maori.

Log 50 hours CPD annually: 12.5h educational activities; 25h performance review + outcome measurement (min 5h each); 12.5h any. Annual PDP. One activity per year each in culturally safe practice, health inequalities, professionalism, ethical practice (within the 50h). CPR every 3 years; ALS2 every 3 years. Page does not mention New Zealand or Maori (Australian framework; no NZ rules found).

NOT VERIFIED from primary page: racma.edu.au returned 403. Search summary only (unconfirmed): 50h/yr, 25h reviewing performance + measuring outcomes, 12.5h education; CAPE domains encouraged in 2025-2026, required from 2027.

NOT VERIFIED from primary page: dermcoll.edu.au returned 403 on both CPD pages. Search summary only (unconfirmed): 50h/yr, 12.5h education, 25h reviewing performance + measuring outcomes, PDP mandatory, four PACE objectives; cultural safety framed around Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander health; no NZ/Maori content found.

AFOEM fellows follow RACP MyCPD: min 50h/yr; Category 1 education min 12.5h; Categories 2+3 min 25h with min 5h each; remaining 12.5h any. Mandatory: PDP, Annual Conversation (no hour values), Cultural Safety and Health Inequities min 2 activities/yr, Ethics and Professional Behaviour min 2 activities/yr. 2026 framework same as 2025; records due 31 Mar 2027. No Maori-specific requirement stated. AFOEM page itself states no CPD rules.

Same RACP MyCPD 2026 framework as AFOEM row (no Public Health-specific CPD rule found). A training-only item (trainees from 2023 complete an Aboriginal, Torres Strait Islander and Maori cultural competence online course) appeared only in a search summary - unverified and not a CPD rule.
